name: steinwall-briefing
description: Daily cost briefing for Codex: what today cost at API list prices, how much of the 5-hour and weekly limits is used, and which stuck loops and risky commands an automatic guard would have caught. Also scans skills, plugins and MCP servers for malicious patterns before you install them. Read-only, runs locally.

interface.longDescription: SteinWall Briefing reads Codex's own session logs on your computer and gives you a daily briefing: cost at API list prices, models, the 5-hour and weekly limits, and an estimate of what stuck loops cost and which risky commands ran (recursive deletes, force pushes, reading secrets, piping downloads into a shell). It also checks skills, plugins and MCP servers for prompt injection, hidden shell commands and data exfiltration before you install them. It only reads, changes nothing and sends nothing.
defaultPrompt: What did Codex cost me this week?
Scan this plugin before I install it
